title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Security Deposits and Accepted Tenders
content:
Security deposit and tender table for Ridgeline Tool Rental, by equipment class.

| Equipment class | Security deposit at checkout, USD | Deposit waived when the rental is charged to an active Ridgeline Pro Credit account | Tenders for a security or reservation deposit | Tenders for rental charges |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 50.00 | yes | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 75.00 | yes | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 100.00 | yes | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 150.00 | yes | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 250.00 | yes | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 500.00 | no | cash, bank card | cash, bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit |

## Notes to the table

1. A deposit, whether a security deposit or a reservation deposit, is taken only in cash or on a bank card in every class; a Ridgeline credit account is not a deposit tender.
2. Rental charges themselves may be paid on any of the four tenders listed, in every class.
3. The waiver column states whether the class allows the security deposit to be waived for a rental charged to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account in active status. Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment is the one class where that waiver is not available.

## Questions answered

- *What deposit does a lawn and landscape item take?* 100.00 at checkout, in cash or on a bank card, where no waiver applies.
- *Can an earthmoving deposit be waived for a Pro Credit customer?* No; the class shows "no" in the waiver column, so the 500.00 deposit is collected.
